youtube.baslik: In implant surgery, how is preservation of residual hearing measured? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The 2013 classification by Skarzynski and colleagues relates the shift between the pre and postoperative low-frequency averages to the residual hearing range and gives preservation as a percentage. Above 75 percent is complete, 25 to 75 percent partial, and below 25 percent minimal preservation; if no measurable hearing remains, there is considered to be no preservation.

Low-frequency thresholds are measured before and after surgery.
The shift, relative to the residual range, is given as a percentage.
Above seventy five percent is complete; below twenty five, minimal.
In between is partial; with no hearing left, there is no preservation.
